About the Role

We are looking for a creative and user\-focused **UI/UX Designer** to join our team. * Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and front\-end development concepts is an added advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Computer Science, Fine Arts, or a related field.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Oracle APEX is trusted worldwide to deliver mission\-critical, data\-driven applications that are secure, scalable, and built on the Oracle Database. Its declarative low\-code platform helps teams build enterprise applications faster, with a clear application model that is easier to understand, maintain, and ready for AI\-assisted development.
  

  

The Oracle APEX Product Management team is looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead the development of Oracle APEX product collateral: training courseware, certification programs, tutorials, LiveLabs, videos, and customer\-facing enablement content, that fuels product adoption and customer success worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise and compelling content craft, You'll turn product capabilities and new feature releases into materials that customers, partners, and internal teams rely on every day to succeed with Oracle APEX.


Beyond collateral development, you'll be a driving force behind customer and partner engagements, proof\-of\-concepts, University, and community and event programs, partnering closely with Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, Cloud Engineering, and Partners to accelerate Oracle APEX adoption globally.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10\+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Marketing, Developer Relations, Customer Success, Sales, Solution Engineering, or Technical Consulting.
* Strong Oracle Database expertise, including SQL, PL/SQL, relational database design, and data modeling.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle APEX application development.
* Proven experience creating technical documentation, training content, tutorials, videos, or other customer\-facing enablement material.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers, partners, and developer communities, including planning and executing events, workshops, or webinars.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives and stakeholders in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is a plus.

  
**Responsibilities**

**Product Collateral Development (Primary Focus)**

* Lead the creation and continuous evolution of Oracle APEX product collateral: training courseware, certification programs, tutorials, LiveLabs, videos, and other high\-impact enablement content.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Sales to ensure every piece of content reflects the platform's latest capabilities and feature releases with precision and clarity.
* Craft customer success stories, blogs, and advocacy content that bring real\-world Oracle APEX impact to life, in collaboration with Marketing, customers, and partners.
* Own the customer approval and publication process for external\-facing collateral, ensuring quality and consistency at every step.
* Build and maintain a content roadmap tied to the product release cycle.
Champion Oracle APEX hosted environments used for demos, workshops, and customer engagements, ensuring they're always ready to make a strong impression.  
* 

  

**Customer\-Centricity**

* Actively engage with customers to gather feedback and insights that inform product direction and content priorities.
* Work with customers to align Oracle APEX capabilities to their business goals, including through hands\-on proof\-of\-concept engagements.
* Capture and analyze customer requirements to inform new product capabilities and feature designs.
* Review and prioritize customer issues to drive satisfaction and quality, coordinating resolutions across teams.
Grow and energize the global Oracle APEX developer community, strengthening ties with User Groups and champions worldwide.  
* 

**Product Release \& Go\-to\-Market**

* Develop release overviews, presentations, and demos that equip field teams to sell and support new capabilities with confidence.
* Recruit and support early adopters to validate new solutions ahead of broader rollout.
* Contribute to the development of clear, accurate user documentation.
* Define and track product adoption metrics, surfacing user behavior trends that inform strategy.
* Present compelling demos to customers, partners, analysts, and field teams that showcase the value of Oracle APEX.
* Help plan and execute high\-visibility events such as roadshows, customer summits, partner round tables, workshops, webinars, and conferences

jobs.title: Product Manager -AI
jobs.description:
**Overview**
 Every AI agent in Prism needs two things to do real work: an accurate, shared picture of how a customer's business fits together, and a safe way to read from and write back to it. The Prism Platform is that shared foundation, a knowledge layer that describes a customer's business objects and rules, a common way of representing data across different underlying ERP systems, and a structured, per\-customer record that carries context cleanly from one part of the system to another. You own how that foundation evolves: what gets modeled, how it's exposed to the teams and agents that depend on it, and how it gets more accurate and more useful the more it's used.
   

  

 This is a product role at the center of the platform, not on top of it. You will work with the teams building specific AI products and workflows to make sure they get what they need from the platform, and with the engineers building the platform itself to decide what gets prioritized next.
   

  

**Epicor**
 Epicor is a technology leader in ERP software for manufacturing, distribution, and retail, with deep roots in both enterprise software and startup culture. Our product organization is in the middle of a deliberate move to a platform\-first, AI\-enabled delivery model: building shared capabilities that many teams can build on, broadening how roles work together, and removing the silos and handoffs that slow good teams down.
   

  

**How This Team Works**
 The biggest change versus a traditional PM job is how the work gets done. We expect this leader to operate fluently in the model below, and to help the rest of the org adopt it.
   

  

* Built as a platform, not a feature. The Prism Platform exists to be depended on by every other part of Prism. Ease of adoption for the teams building on it, and the quality of the shared foundation it provides, are the real measures of success, not any single feature.
* A small team, not a feature factory. Delivery happens in a lean, cross\-functional team working closely together against a system with built\-in human oversight. You are inside that loop as the product decision\-maker, not reviewing status from the outside.
* Roles blur on a team like this. The lines between product, engineering, design, and architecture blur on a team this size. You work directly in specs, cross\-team sequencing decisions, and real usage data, not a backlog handed over a wall. You keep clear ownership of product scope and decisions while picking up adjacent work that a small team requires.
* Evidence. Decisions about what the platform should model and expose next are grounded in real demand from the teams and agents that depend on it, not opinion. You own the success criteria.
* Reuse before rebuilding. The whole point of a shared foundation is that other teams stop building their own version of the same thing. You own the shared set of building blocks other teams draw from, and keep it coherent as more teams build on it.
* Share openly. Open questions, usage patterns, and outcomes are shared across the org so people can see clearly what the platform can and can't yet promise.


**What We’d Love To See**
* Empathy for two different customers. Real understanding of the end customer whose business data and context flow through the platform, and of the engineering and product teams deciding whether to build on it or work around it. You validate both before committing to a build.
* A platform mindset. You think about ease of adoption, reusable building blocks, and how many teams choose to build on your system the way a good platform product manager thinks about retention, not the way a feature team thinks about a single roadmap.
* Working Backwards: Demonstrates mastery of customer empathy, working backwards from customer pain points to validate the customer problems, ideal customer profiles, and value propositions.
* ‘Founder Mode’ Mindset: Demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit by taking full ownership, embracing creative problem\-solving, and relentlessly challenging the status quo to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* Prototyping Pro: Quickly generates prototypes to get early feedback from internal stakeholders and customers.
* Strategic Direction \& Prioritization: Lead the orchestration of strategic direction and set priorities for our AI applications and functionalities. Define the vision and roadmap that drive innovation in AI\-driven products.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Own the platform vision and roadmap. Decide what gets modeled, exposed, and improved next, and keep the roadmap tied to real demand from the teams and products building on it, not to technical completeness for its own sake.
* Own how business context is represented. Define what a customer's business objects, rules, and data look like in a common, structured way, so every team and agent that reads from the platform gets the same, accurate picture regardless of which underlying ERP a customer runs.
* Own the per\-customer context record. Own the structured record that carries a customer's context cleanly from one part of the system to another, so nothing gets lost as work moves between different Prism products.
* Own the read and write\-back loop. Decide what agents and workflows are allowed to write back into the platform as they learn, and how that gets validated, so the foundation improves with use instead of drifting.
* Own the connection to the ERP. Own how the platform exposes ERP data and business logic to the rest of Prism in a consistent way, so other teams build against one clean interface instead of many inconsistent ones.
* Own the catalog of what's built on the platform. Own the system that keeps track of which agents, workflows, and tools exist, what they're allowed to touch, and who's using them, so the platform stays legible as more gets built on it.

**Job Title: Product Manager (PM\-L1 / PM\-L2\)** 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (HITEC City)
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Friday (5 Days)
 



  





**Job Summary** 




  





 We are hiring for
 **Product Manager PM\-L1 and PM\-L2** 
 levels. The final level will be determined based on the candidate's experience, product ownership, and interview performance. As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining product strategy, identifying customer problems, driving AI\-first product development, and delivering scalable web and mobile solutions. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Business, and Growth teams to create products that enhance learner experiences while achieving business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Strategy \& Discovery** 




  




* Translate business strategy into a clear product vision, roadmap, and execution milestones.
* Conduct customer discovery through interviews with students, mentors, employers, and internal stakeholders.
* Apply Jobs\-to\-Be\-Done (JTBD) methodology, customer journey mapping, and user research to identify opportunities.
* Perform market research, competitive analysis, opportunity sizing, and build\-versus\-buy evaluations.
* Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.



  





**AI\-First Product Development** 




  




* Design and deliver AI\-powered product features using:
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* AI Agents
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Intelligent automation workflows



  




* Create detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and Design Requirement Documents (DRDs).
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and QA teams to deliver high\-quality products.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, prioritization, and release planning across multiple initiatives.



  





**Product Analytics \& Growth** 




  




* Define product success metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Implement event tracking and product instrumentation.
* Build dashboards to monitor feature adoption, engagement, retention, and business performance.
* Design and execute A/B tests to validate product hypotheses.
* Analyze funnels, cohorts, retention, and user behavior to identify optimization opportunities.
* Partner with Growth teams to improve activation, engagement, retention, and SEO/content strategies.



  





**Stakeholder Management \& Go\-to\-Market** 




  




* Collaborate with Business Owners, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales, and Leadership teams.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment through structured documentation and decision\-making.
* Support product launches by preparing release notes, enablement materials, and GTM plans.
* Ensure effective communication throughout the product lifecycle.



  





**Product Quality \& Responsible AI** 




  




* Own product quality before, during, and after launch.
* Plan safe feature rollouts with monitoring, guardrails, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure learner privacy, data security, and responsible AI implementation.
* Monitor product adoption and continuously improve user experience based on customer feedback.



  





**EdTech Product Innovation** 




  




* Incorporate pedagogy, learning science, assessment integrity, and accessibility into product development.
* Collaborate with Curriculum and Content teams to improve educational experiences and learning outcomes.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





**Must Have** 




  




* 3\+ years of Product Management experience with end\-to\-end product ownership (01 and/or 1N products).
* Proven experience delivering impactful product initiatives from ideation through launch.
* Strong analytical skills with hands\-on experience in:
* SQL
* Google Sheets / Excel
* Product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.
* Exposure to AI technologies and frameworks, including:
* OpenAI APIs
* AI Agents
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* Vector Databases
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Familiarity with AI development tools such as Lovable, Replit, and CrewAI.
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
* Strong prioritization, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience in EdTech, Learning Science, Gamification, or Subscription\-based products.
* Experience integrating payment gateways, identity platforms, or CRM systems.
* Exposure to revenue optimization, cost management, or pricing initiatives.
* Experience managing multiple cross\-functional teams and complex product portfolios.



**Success Metrics (First 90180 Days)** 



* Deliver two or more key product milestones that positively impact learning outcomes or business KPIs.
* Establish a strong experimentation culture through continuous measurement, learning, and iteration.
* Improve stakeholder satisfaction through structured planning, communication, and timely execution.
* Drive measurable improvements in product adoption, engagement, and customer experience.



  





**Educational Qualification** 




  




* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Information Technology, or a related discipline.



  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Annual Performance Bonus
* Multi\-Year Retention Component

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
   

  

**Your opportunity**
 At New Relic, Principal Product Managers act as company\-level leaders with unparalleled vision, deep strategic thinking, and an obsession with driving business outcomes through customer value. As a
 **Principal Product Manager for Distributed Tracing, Data** 
 , you'll join a world\-class team at the heart of modern observability, shaping the future of how developers understand their complex, microservice\-based architectures.
   

  

 In this highly\-visible and strategic role, you will be the single\-threaded owner for Distributed Tracing instrumentation and onboarding, setting the long\-term vision and strategy and working closely with the broader Distributed Tracing and APM teams. You will be responsible for defining how New Relic wins in this critical market, balancing the needs of our largest enterprise customers with bold, forward\-looking innovations. If you are a high\-agency leader who wants to solve some of the most complex challenges in software observability and make a massive impact, this role is a perfect fit for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as a true "full business owner": Set the multi\-year vision and strategy for the Distributed Tracing product, identifying market\-defining opportunities and marshalling the resources to capitalize on them.
* Drive industry\-wide thought leadership: Represent New Relic as a subject matter expert on Distributed Tracing in customer EBCs, at industry conferences, and in strategic roadmap conversations with our largest accounts.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle: Guide your product from ideation through design, development, and successful go\-to\-market launch, ensuring it meets the highest standards of quality and user experience.
* Mentor and up\-level the team: Act as a mentor for other product managers, helping to elevate the craft of product management within the organization through your example and guidance.
* Partner across the business: Collaborate closely with executive leadership, engineering, design, marketing, support, and sales teams to deliver end\-to\-end value and ensure cohesive GTM execution.
* Engage deeply with strategic customers: Build and maintain strong relationships with our most strategic customers and partners to deeply understand their use cases and guide your roadmap.
* Build a data\-informed, business\-oriented roadmap: Define and analyze product metrics to ensure your strategy meets and exceeds key business objectives.
* Communicate with executive\-level clarity: Articulate your vision, strategy, and roadmap effectively to C\-level executives and senior leadership, bringing clarity and driving alignment on complex, ambiguous initiatives.


**This role requires**
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience; a background in Computer Science or a related technical field is strongly preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience building and launching highly technical products as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of success in a senior or principal role.
* A fierce bias for action and proactive ownership: You are known for setting your own direction and driving mission\-critical initiatives with a high degree of autonomy and strategic influence.
* Deep domain expertise in observability, cloud\-native technologies, or distributed systems. You should be comfortable leading deep technical conversations with architects and principal engineers.
* A proven ability to analyze complex qualitative and quantitative data and use it to drive high\-impact business and product outcomes.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership.
* A deep sense of customer empathy and extensive experience shipping engaging and delightful experiences for a technical developer audience.


**Bonus points if you have**
* Direct experience with observability products/tools, especially in the Distributed Tracing or APM space (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin).
* Prior SaaS product experience with a developer persona.
* Experience with enterprise B2B products and navigating complex sales cycles.
* Familiarity with public cloud infrastructure services (AWS / Azure / GCP) and modern container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to play a critical role in strengthening the organization's analytics foundation through business intelligence and data analytics delivery, supported by data discovery and centralization.
This role is accountable for producing high\-quality, scalable analytics and dashboards that support decision\-making, while also improving clarity and consistency across distributed data systems.
The individual in this role serves as a trusted owner of analytical integrity, responsible for defining and maintaining metric logic, validating data availability and definitions, and ensuring analytics are built on clearly understood and well\-documented data sources.
Success requires technical depth, analytical rigor, and the ability to balance day\-to\-day analytics delivery with ongoing data discovery in a decentralized data environment.


Responsibilities:
#### **Business Intelligence and Data Analytics**

* Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards and analytical solutions that support operational, strategic, and ad hoc analytical needs.
* Own metrics and KPIs end\-to\-end, including definition, calculation logic, validation, and ongoing consistency.
* Translate business questions into analytical approaches, dashboards, reports, and supporting data structures.
* Ensure analytics are accurate, well\-documented, and aligned with agreed\-upon metric definitions.
* Provide ongoing analytical support to stakeholders, including investigations, deep dives, and clarification of results.

#### **Data Discovery, Centralization and Documentation**

* Lead data discovery efforts to determine whether required data exists, how it is defined, and where it resides.
* Identify equivalent or related data elements across systems and document authoritative sources.
* Support data centralization and consolidation by identifying overlaps, gaps, and inconsistencies across datasets.
* Create and maintain documentation that supports repeatable analytics, metric consistency, and long\-term scalability.

#### **Data Quality and Accuracy**

* Validate data used in dashboards and analyses to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Identify data limitations, definition gaps, or quality issues and clearly communicate their impact.
* Promote consistent interpretation and responsible use of metrics across teams.

#### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Create BI dashboards and analytical outputs in close partnership with business, product, and technical teams.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day analytics partner supporting decision\-making through data and insights.
* Communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and limitations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Operate effectively in environments with evolving documentation and distributed data ownership.


Qualifications:

Required:  

* Advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
* Advanced SQL skills with experience querying complex, multi\-schema, multi\-source data environments.
* Strong experience delivering BI dashboards, recurring analytics, and ad hoc analysis for business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience operating in decentralized or federated data environments.
* Experience contributing to data inventories, cataloging efforts, or metric standardization initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience with modern BI and visualization tools (for example, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent).


Preferred:  

* Experience with data modeling, analytics engineering, or data science practices.
* Exposure to statistical analysis or advanced analytical techniques.
* Familiarity with formal data governance or data quality frameworks.

jobs.title: Functional Expert — Merchandising solutions
jobs.description:
**Digital Commerce Functional Expert — Merchandising solutions**
**Function**
 Digital Commercial \& Growth Hub
   

  

**Reports To**
 Digital Commerce Product Head
   

  

**Scope**
 Global — Own the Store Program
   

  

**About The Team**
 You will join the Digital Commerce team within the Digital Growth Hub \& Commercial function. The team manages a global portfolio of applications that support commercial operations, including integrations with business functions and external partners.
   

  

 In this role, you will focus on merchandising solutions — specifically TRAX, an AI\-powered image recognition platform that underpins the global "Own the Store" program. TRAX gives Merchandisers and Trade Marketing teams real\-time visibility into in\-store shelf execution and compliance.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
**A — Merchandising solutions — Functional Expert**
 Support The End\-to\-end Product Lifecycle For Merchandising Solutions Such As TRAX Underpinning The Own The Store Program Globally, Serving Merchandisers, Trade Marketing Teams, And Commercial Operations
   

  

**Product Backlog \& Delivery Support**
* Lead Definition and update of the TRAX product backlog, translating business requirements from the Own the Store program into well\-defined requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Write functional specifications and ensuring stories are ready for development (Definition of Ready) and meet quality standards upon delivery (Definition of Done).
* Track and monitor delivery progress, flagging risks or blockers
* Duly support issues resolutions as per Support governance


**Own the Store Program — Merchandising Solutions enablement Support**
* Support the rollout and continuous improvement of Merchandising solutions features (e.g. TRAX) enabling Merchandisers to capture, validate, and act on shelf execution data (planogram compliance, share of shelf, product availability) aligned with the Own the Store program globally.
* Partner with Trade Marketing and Merchandising business owners to understand in\-store execution workflows and translate them into prioritised merchandising solutions requirements and platform enhancements.
* Assist in driving adoption of Merchandising solutions capabilities enabling store managers and field teams to monitor shelf compliance and take corrective action in real time based on AI\-detected insights.
* Support the configuration and localisation of Merchandising solutions models to meet market\-specific planogram standards, category requirements, and regional compliance.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) cycles, coordinating with market teams and ensuring business sign\-off on new recognition models, features, and releases.


**Integrations \& Data**
* Collaborate with technical teams to support seamless integration between Merchandising solutions and related systems (CRM, field force tools, reporting and BI platforms).
* Help define KPIs and measurement frameworks to track Own the Store program performance through Merchandising solutions analytics (OSA, planogram compliance scores, share of shelf, perfect store metrics).
* Assist in monitoring image capture quality and recognition model accuracy, flagging data inconsistencies that may impact field reporting or decision\-making.


**Vendor \& Support Coordination**
* Act as a point of contact for day\-to\-day coordination with the Merchandising solotuions vendor (e.g. TRAX), ensuring support tickets are properly triaged and SLAs are respected.
* Escalate recurring issues and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives with the vendor.


**B — Product Governance \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Handle product governance with Merchandising Solution teams (TRAX) ensuring product roadmap is delivered on time as per expectations.
* Maintain product documentation, user guides, release notes, and training materials for Merchandising solutions (e.g. TRAX) and the Own the Store program.
* Liaise with regional and market teams globally to gather field feedback and usage insights.
* Monitor product performance metrics and user adoption; contribute data\-driven inputs to roadmap prioritisation.
* Stay informed on Merchandising solutions product roadmap updates and evaluate new image recognition and retail execution capabilities relevant to merchandising and trade performance.


**Required Qualifications \& Background**
**Education**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing, Business or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
   

  

**Junior Product / PO Experience**
 First experience (internship, apprenticeship, or 3–5 years) as a Junior Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a digital product / project role. Exposure to agile delivery is a plus.
   

  

**Image Recognition / Retail Tech**
 Basic understanding of image recognition, computer vision, or retail execution platforms. Experience with TRAX or similar shelf intelligence / perfect store tools is a strong advantage.
   

  

**FMCG / FMCH Industry**
 Some exposure to FMCG or FMCH commercial operations, trade marketing, or field\-force environments is appreciated but not mandatory.
   

  

**Data \& Analytics**
 Comfort with data analysis, KPI tracking, and reporting tools. Ability to interpret dashboards and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
   

  

**Agile**
 Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe); basic knowledge of backlog management tools such as Jira and Confluence.
   

  

**Skills \& Profile**
* Proactive and autonomous — able to manage multiple priorities in a global, matrixed organisation.
* Clear communicator, adaptable to field, product, technical, and finance audiences.
* Detail\-oriented with genuine curiosity for digital commerce, Retail execution and FMCG.

Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies. The Trust and Safety offering within Accenture Operations helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. Content moderators serve as an important line of defence by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands\-on job experience. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society. You will be responsible for analysing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, the user may be exposed to flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Content moderation is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe. It may also be challenging, at times. In the context of this role, individuals may be directly or inadvertently exposed to potentially objectionable and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious). Therefore, content moderators need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well\-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their job role responsibilities. Active participation in Accenture’s well\-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust \& Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well\-being. As the Content Review Lead, your primary purpose is to oversee and guide a team of content reviewers in their efforts to maintain a safe and positive user experience on the platform. You will play a crucial role in upholding our community guidelines, policies, and legal standards by ensuring that all user\-generated content complies with client regulations. Your leadership will be instrumental in fostering a high\-performing team that effectively and efficiently moderates content, identifies potential risks, and takes appropriate actions to uphold the integrity of the platform.In your role as a lead, you may also be expected to analyze and review user profiles, audios, videos, and text\-based content and/or investigate the escalated flags and/or resolve issues that are reported.
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**
* 
* Team Management: Lead and support a team of content reviewers, setting clear expectations and providing ongoing coaching and feedback. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment that encourages open communication and professional growth.
* Business Operator: Oversee content review processes, ensuring that all user\-generated content is promptly and accurately reviewed according to established guidelines. Make well\-informed decisions on escalated or sensitive content cases, adhering to company policies and legal requirements.

 As BA, you'll own requirement discovery and documentation across SmartWheels' multi\-product line from hardware based telematics to hardware less IOT solutions. You'll write and refine user stories for frontend, backend and web workstreams, run sprint ceremonies alongside the Scrum Master/PM, and act as the day\-to\-day bridge between business stakeholders, customers, and engineering.

 • Gather and analyze requirements from stakeholders, customers, and support/sales teams across all product lines

 • 5\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in a software product company; SaaS, IoT, telematics, or fleet/GPS tracking domain strongly preferred.

 • Hands\-on expertise with Jira for backlog management, sprint boards, and reporting; comfortable configuring workflows and epics/stories/subtasks.

**Job title: Business system owner HighRadius Cloud–Analyst**
* Location: Hyderabad


**About The Job**
 Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability \& interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.
   

  

 In The Context Of Our Digital Transformation, We Are Upgrading HighRadius Cloud To Support Customer Invoicing To Cash Activities And More Specifically Collections And Cash Application Management. We Are Enhancing This Platform With Advanced Automation And Analytics Capabilities To Drive Collector Efficiency, Improve DSO Performance, And Deliver Operational Excellence Across 80\+ Countries. Reporting To The BSO Manager – HighRadius Cloud Collections \& Cash Application, The BSO Analyst Assists In The Day\-to\-day Operations Of The HighRadius Cloud Platform For Collections And Cash Application Across 80\+ Countries. The Main Activities Include
   

  

* She/he assists in leveraging HighRadius Cloud solution capabilities, including automation and analytics, to deliver the highest value possible to Collections and Cash Application activities on a daily basis.
* She/he participates in business activities in the context of the HighRadius upgrade across 80\+ countries to facilitate collector adoption, reduce DSO, and improve cash application automation, in collaboration with K\-users, Digital, and the HighRadius vendor.
* She/he monitors global adoption (target: 85%\+ daily collector login) and tracks platform performance.


 This role requires a good understanding of Collections and Cash Application processes within the Order to Cash cycle, a problem\-solving mindset, and hands\-on knowledge of HighRadius Cloud (Collections and Cash Application modules), ticket management, and testing activities.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Support HighRadius Cloud platform operations for Collections and Cash Application: Monitor platform health and overnight job completion. Execute review of collector worklist generation and anomalies. Assist in ticket triage and routing of incoming support tickets (L1/L2\). Verify SAP ↔ HighRadius data sync (AR balances, master data). Track strategy execution monitoring and automation rate performance. Update rule\-based collection strategies Review open incidents and maintain oversight of SLA compliance. Maintain KPI dashboard updates and overdue trend reports. Monitor collector adoption metrics (login/worklist usage rate).

Prepare business specifications for Digital and HighRadius. Execute UAT preparation: test scripts, key user training materials, test coordination. Track and report on execution and incident resolution during UAT. Deliver key user responsibilities during end\-user training sessions.

Execute regression testing activities before platform changes go live. Present expected enhancements in partnership with Digital to the appropriate governance (Design Authority, ERP screening committee).

Monitor post\-launch initiatives: overdue improvement, collector productivity, auto\-match rates. Track KPI performance: DSO trends, overdue rates, worklist completion rates, auto\-match rates. Ensure Reporting and Analytics needs are met: deliver daily collector dashboards, management reporting, overdue trend analysis, and cash application performance tracking.
* Maintain data foundation build and KPI enhancement for HighRadius data. Validate data accuracy in reports and dashboards. Update and maintain training documentation. Communicate to stakeholders about feature delivery and platform updates. Build HighRadius platform expertise within the K\-user community (SME’s).
* Participate in HighRadius vendor relationship and ticket governance:Track SLA compliance across all incident priorities (P1–P4\). Attend monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with HighRadius. Record and maintain all configuration changes and change requests in ServiceNow. Manage the Change Request (CR) pipeline tracking. Execute HighRadius ticket governance in ServiceNow: priority classification, RCA documentation follow\-up, resolution tracking. Document root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents. Verify regression testing checklists are completed before UAT.


**About You**
* Experience: 2–3 years' experience in Collections and/or Cash Application within an Order to Cash environment (essential). Experience with HighRadius in a multinational company (essential). Experience supporting Business System Owner (BSO) responsibilities and governance. Hands\-on experience with HighRadius Collections and/or Cash Application modules (essential). jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I ( Product Owner- Sports Products)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about powering a better media future for all people by providing powerful, essential insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content—wherever and whenever it's consumed.
   

  

 Gracenote, a Nielsen Company, is the world's leading provider of entertainment metadata and content IDs. We sit at the intersection of media, technology, and data, helping the world's largest entertainment brands connect people to the content they love.
   

  

 Gracenote Sports is a global operation that collects, manages, and delivers live results and comprehensive sports data across all major global and local leagues—from the Premier League, NFL, and Formula 1 to the Olympics and IPL—serving customers who rely on accurate, real\-time sports information.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a hands\-on product owner to support the Gracenote Sports product team in building, consolidating, and delivering our sports data and product ecosystem. In this role, you will work closely with the lead Product Manager to ensure development teams have well\-defined backlogs, clear priorities, and a deep understanding of the "what" and "why" behind their work. Critically, you will also serve as the bridge between product strategy and engineering execution—able to understand and communicate the "how" in both directions.
   

  

 Gracenote Sports is at a pivotal point: unifying legacy platforms into a single, consolidated database and tooling ecosystem, while simultaneously designing a data model capable of representing the full diversity of global sports and competition formats—and delivering that data through customer\-facing products (Global Sports Data API, Global Sports Widgets). This role will be instrumental in accelerating that transformation by embedding product ownership directly within engineering teams and ensuring day\-to\-day delivery stays aligned with the broader sports product roadmap.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines a genuine passion for sports with strong product ownership fundamentals—someone who thrives in the detail of backlog management, ticket creation, grooming, and testing while maintaining sight of the bigger picture across platform, data pipelines, and frontend delivery products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and manage backlogs for one or more engineering squads: translate PRDs and roadmap priorities into well\-structured engineering tickets with clear acceptance criteria, and keep backlogs prioritized and ready for development.
* Conduct grooming and sprint planning sessions with engineering teams; ensure teams understand what they are building, why it matters, and how it fits the broader roadmap.
* Serve as a two\-way translator between product and engineering: communicate product intent to developers, and explain technical approach and trade\-offs back to stakeholders.
* Perform hands\-on testing and validation of tooling, data pipeline, and product changes, ensuring quality and correctness before release.
* Work flexibly across multiple teams and product areas—including the data collection tooling team (Mumbai), the data platform team, the data processing team, and the frontend delivery products (Global Sports Data API, Global Sports Widgets)—providing product ownership where it is most needed.
* Challenge existing technical approaches and legacy patterns. Bring alternative perspectives to engineering discussions and push teams to consider better, more scalable solutions rather than defaulting to the status quo.
* Develop a solid understanding of the full sports product portfolio, the various sports and competition formats being modeled, and the data flows from collection through to customer\-facing product delivery.
* Support migration and consolidation efforts by helping define requirements for data migration, tool unification, database integration, and data model design that accommodates diverse sports and competition formats.


**A Day in the Life**
 Your morning starts with a standup for one of the platform teams. A developer has questions about how a new competition format (say, a multi\-stage cycling race) should be represented in the data model—you pull up the PRD, walk through the expected behavior, and sketch out the edge cases together.
   

  

 Mid\-morning, you're grooming tickets for the next sprint with a different squad working on the Global Sports Data API. You challenge a proposed approach that mirrors a legacy pattern: "Why are we doing it this way? Could we handle this more generically so it works for athletics too?" The engineer pushes back, you discuss trade\-offs, and together you land on a better solution.
   

  

 After lunch, you're testing a tooling release with the Mumbai team—clicking through the data entry workflows, verifying that the new football league they onboarded last week flows correctly from collection tool to database to API output. You find an edge case, log a bug with clear reproduction steps, and flag it before it ships.
   

  

 Late afternoon, you sync with the lead Product Manager. You report back on where the teams are, flag a dependency between the platform team and the widget team, and discuss whether a migration milestone needs to shift. You translate engineering's "we need two more sprints because of X" into language that makes sense for the roadmap discussion and improvements to avoid a shift in the future.
   

  

 Between meetings, you're scanning the backlog—re\-prioritizing based on what you learned today, writing acceptance criteria for a ticket that was too vague, and archiving stories that are no longer relevant.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 3–5\+ years of experience in a product management or product owner role, ideally within a data\-intensive or platform\-oriented environment.

Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

* In\-depth industry knowledge and experience with digital advertising standards and protocols, particularly in CTV and OTT, and familiarity with industry standards desired.


**Additional Information**

Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
 


  
 
 Senior Product Manager \- Intelligent Events, Health, and SLOs
 



  

**Role Summary:** 




 This Senior Product Manager will own the strategy for how SolarWinds defines, measures, and communicates the reliability and operational health of customer systems.  The core focus is transforming raw observability data into actionable, intelligent events and proactive health scores, directly enabling customer Service Level Objective (SLO) management and incident reduction.  This role drives the product vision for event correlation and anomaly detection, ensuring our platform moves customers from reactive monitoring to proactive incident prevention.  Success will be measured by the adoption of SLO features, the reduction in alert volume for customers, and the quality of system health scoring.
 



  

**Core Responsibilities:** 




 Define the product strategy and roadmap for Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs), ensuring seamless configuration, tracking, and reporting for our enterprise users.  Lead the development of the event management platform, focusing on advanced correlation, root cause analysis, and proprietary noise reduction techniques to combat alert fatigue.  Establish a unified, platform\-wide health and risk scoring model that synthesizes metrics, logs, and traces into a single, understandable view of system wellness.  Collaborate with machine learning and engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven anomaly detection and predictive alerting features for the proactive identification of impending issues.  Must be the voice of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) persona, translating industry best practices into powerful, simple\-to\-use product features.
 



  

**Required Qualifications:** 




 Deep domain expertise in AIOps, event management, and Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, with specific experience in defining and launching SLO/SLI features.  Proven experience in product managing technical platforms that leverage data science, machine learning, or statistical models for event correlation and anomaly detection.  Strong working knowledge of how observability data (metrics, logs, traces) is used to calculate system health and drive automated workflows.  Must possess impeccable oral and written communications skills, exceptional leadership capabilities to drive cross\-functional alignment, and proven expertise in product strategy and product management fundamentals.  Demonstrated ability to deliver features that fundamentally improve a customer’s operational efficiency and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager- Remote
jobs.description:
**About Cimpress** 




 Cimpress is the world leader in mass customization. Through our technology, production, and supply chain capabilities, Cimpress businesses make it possible for customers around the world to personalize physical products and have them manufactured on demand, with high quality, speed, reliability, and affordability.
 



 Our Mass Customization Platform, or MCP, is a modular, multi\-tenant platform used by Cimpress businesses including Vistaprint, Pixartprinting, Tradeprint, Drukwerkdeal, National Pen, and others. MCP enables our businesses to create, configure, sell, manufacture, and fulfill a vast range of customizable products across global markets.
 



  





**About the Product Catalog Domain**




 The Product Catalog Domain owns the central product information and product modeling capabilities used across Cimpress businesses. Our core product, the MCP PIM, is much more than a traditional Product Information Management system. It supports the data and workflows needed to define, enrich, sell, fulfill, and operate customizable products across merchants, suppliers, marketplaces, and downstream systems
 



 .The PIM touches many parts of the mass customization value chain, including product attributes, product models, pricing, merchandising, supplier integrations, inventory feeds, fulfillment configuration, production constraints, and product launch workflows
 



 .Within the Product Catalog Domain, the Supplier PIM focuses on the supplier side of the product catalog: the product data and operational capabilities required to connect Cimpress businesses with internal and external production partners
 



  





**.About the Role**




 We are looking for a highly technical Senior Product Manager to own
 **Supplier Product Data** 
 within the Supplier PIM.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys complex platform product management, data modeling, supplier integrations, operational workflows, and AI\-enabled product transformation. You will work on the systems and capabilities that allow Cimpress businesses to understand what suppliers can produce, how those products can be configured, how they can be manufactured, what constraints apply, and how supplier data should be made available to merchants, websites, pricing systems, order flows, and fulfillment integrations.
 



 You will partner closely with engineering leads, product leads, squad leads, UX, product operations, supplier\-facing teams, Cimpress businesses, and technology leadership. You will be expected to create product strategy, shape roadmaps, drive execution, and help the domain use emeaningfully to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of supplier product data management.
 



 This is not a role for someone who simply collects requirements and writes tickets. We are looking for a product leader who can deeply understand a complex domain, create clarity from ambiguity, challenge assumptions, work effectively with highly technical teams, and build platform capabilities that scale across many businesses and suppliers.
 



  





**What You Will Do**




**Own the product strategy for Supplier Product Data** 



* Define and communicate the vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for Supplier Product Data within the Supplier PIM.
* Identify the highest\-value opportunities to improve supplier product data quality, onboarding speed, platform scalability, and downstream usability.
* Balance short\-term delivery needs with the long\-term evolution of the supplier product model.
* Translate complex supplier, merchant, operational, and technical needs into coherent product capabilities.



**Improve how Cimpress models supplier capabilities** 



* Help define how supplier product data should be represented across products, attributes, capabilities, constraints, lead times, packaging, delivery options, and fulfillment rules.
* Partner with engineering teams to determine what should be standardized, what should be configurable, and what should remain supplier\- or business\-specific.
* Support the evolution of reusable product\-data abstractions that reduce one\-off engineering work and make supplier onboarding easier.
* Help prevent the PIM from becoming either too rigid for real supplier complexity or too flexible to govern effectively.



**Drive AI\-enabled transformation** 



* Identify practical AI use cases for supplier product data, such as data mapping, data quality detection, supplier onboarding assistance, attribute recommendations, anomaly detection, documentation, support workflows, and operational decision support.
* Use AI personally and professionally to improve product discovery, analysis, communication, and execution.
* Design AI\-assisted workflows with appropriate human review, confidence thresholds, auditability, evaluation methods, and risk controls.
* Separate high\-value AI opportunities from superficial “AI for AI’s sake” ideas.



**Lead complex cross\-functional execution** 



* Work with engineering leads, squad leads, UX, product operations, and other product managers to turn strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Manage dependencies across teams, domains, businesses, and supplier\-facing workflows.
* Make clear prioritization decisions in an environment with many stakeholders and competing needs.
* Communicate tradeoffs, risks, decisions, and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.



**Create measurable business and platform impact** 



* Define metrics that show whether Supplier Product Data capabilities are improving onboarding speed, data quality, supplier integration reliability, operational productivity, product launch velocity, and downstream adoption.
* Use qualitative and quantitative data to guide product decisions.
* Build feedback loops with users, internal teams, suppliers, and Cimpress businesses.
* Continuously inspect whether product investments are creating reusable platform value rather than isolated local so…

Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. jobs.title: Associate Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Associate Business Analyst**
==============================

Category: Finance
Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN  

**Company:** Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)

  

Are you ready to bring your financial expertise to a role where numbers tell the story of life\-changing medicines reaching patients around the world? Do you thrive in an environment where your analytical mindset and proactive approach can drive real improvements across global processes? If so, read on and apply today for a life\-changing career.

  


**Your new role**



As an Associate Business Analyst within our Finance Global Business Services (GBS), you will play a key role in closing financial books, driving cost calculations and ensuring high\-quality deliverables for Product Supply. You will work closely with Senior Analysts and Process Experts to deliver reliable financial information, drive continuous improvements and act as a process owner on behalf of Finance GBS.



Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will include:


* Closing the financial books for Comp. 1000 inventory and COGS in compliance with accounting principles, and reporting to corporate functions according to internal guidelines
* Performing cost price calculation, validation and governance of Product Supply products in the NN AB process, including reporting of inventory valuation and COGS impact
* Calculating and determining Global Full Manufacturing Costs, Variable Cost and Full Cost across Novo Nordisk, while ensuring Product Supply SOX compliance
* Supporting monthly and budget allocations, following up on interface accounts and performing reconciliations, weekly costing and forwarding for mark \& release
* Driving Month\-End Close activities, including analysis and calculation of accruals/repostings, raw material deviation controlling (PPV, production variance, inventory adjustments) and scrap reporting
* Actively participating in monthly stakeholder meetings, key learning sessions and driving the development of new tools, processes and FP\&A and GBS Finance initiatives
* Raising red flags when needed, identifying mitigating actions together with Senior Analysts and providing recommendations to stakeholders

  


**Your new department**



In Finance, Legal \& Global Solutions, we enable Novo Nordisk to fulfil our purpose by safeguarding the business, providing corporate infrastructure, and driving value creation. We are a team of 2,300 colleagues primarily based at our headquarters in Denmark and our Global Business Services centres in India and Mexico.



You will join the FP\&A team within Finance GBS, a collaborative and ambitious unit that partners closely with our colleagues in Denmark to deliver high\-quality financial controlling and planning support to Product Supply. Here, you will find a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and cross\-functional collaboration, where your contribution directly supports the financial backbone of our global manufacturing operations.

  


**Your skills \& qualifications**



We are looking for a driven and analytical finance professional who enjoys working with numbers as much as with people, and who is energised by improving the way things are done. To succeed in this role, you bring:


* A Master's degree in Finance, ICWA, CMA (or equivalent) from a well\-recognised institute, with a strong academic track record
* 3\-7 years of relevant work experience, ideally within manufacturing accounting and product costing, with a solid understanding of production accounting and finance
* Proficiency with PC tools, including extensive knowledge of MS Office, SAP ECC and SAP BW
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to provide clear recommendations even under uncertainty and pressure, and the ability to handle and prioritise several tasks at once
* A proactive, self\-propelled mindset, strong communication and presentation skills, and a genuine team\-player attitude
* Fluency in oral and written English

  


**Working at Novo Nordisk**



At Novo Nordisk, every role connects directly to our mission of defeating serious chronic diseases – and yours is no exception. For over a century, we have stayed true to that purpose, reaching more patients today than ever before. We are a company at a defining moment, where ambition, accountability and teamwork meet a genuine care for our people. Here, you will be surrounded by driven, talented colleagues who push each other to go further, while you grow as a whole person – professionally and personally. When you join us, you become part of a story that spans generations and shapes the future of healthcare.

  


**What we offer**



There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

  


**Deadline**



30 July 2026\.



Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

  



At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

jobs.description:
**Dyson IT**

 Global IT plays a critical role in enabling Dyson’s engineering teams to deliver world class innovation through scalable, reliable, and forward\-thinking digital platforms.
   

  

**Our RDD IT Team**
 The RDD IT function has end\-to\-end accountability for the design, delivery, and support of the systems that enable Dyson’s global research, engineering, and product development communities.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Engineering platforms such as PLM (Teamcenter), CAE, simulation, and digital engineering tooling
* Global product development systems and processes
* Delivery of transformation initiatives and operational IT services across multiple global sites


**The Role**
 The Technical Product Manager – PLM is responsible for defining, owning, and evolving technical products within the RDD IT landscape, with a particular focus on the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) stack.
   

  

 Operating within the RDD IT function, this role ensures that PLM product roadmaps are aligned to engineering needs and business priorities, translating complex requirements into structured plans for delivery. You will act as a key interface between engineering stakeholders, solution architects, and delivery teams, ensuring that solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned to industry best practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to oversee the quality of delivery, drive continuous improvement across product and application lifecycles, and contribute to the long\-term evolution of Dyson’s engineering technology landscape.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
 Product Strategy \& Roadmap
   

  

* Create and maintain an IT product development roadmap for PLM (Teamcenter) capabilities
* Ensure roadmaps reflect technical thought leadership and industry best practices
* Align product direction to engineering requirements and business priorities
* Continuously review and refine roadmap based on stakeholder input and delivery outcomes

* Act as an ambassador for Global IT across RDD and NPI stakeholder groups
* Engage with senior RDD stakeholders, engineers, solution architects, and business process owners
* Build strong working relationships across delivery, support, and engineering teams
* Ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and product direction

* Collaborate with delivery teams and external partners to ensure successful execution
* Support resolution of delivery challenges and ensure continuous improvement


 Platform Ownership \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Take joint accountability for the robustness and maturity of PLM platforms
* Support and improve product management and application delivery practices
* Identify opportunities to enhance system capabilities and user experience
* Drive continuous improvement across product lifecycle and service delivery


 Vendor \& Partner Management
   

  

* Work with external strategic partners to bring industry insight and best practice
* Collaborate with Legal and Procurement to maximise value from third\-party engagements
* Support development of long\-term platform capability and vendor strategy


 Technology Strategy \& Innovation
   

  

* Support architecture teams and strategic partners in shaping future platform direction
* Contribute to adoption of new technologies and industry trends within RDD IT
* Identify opportunities to improve capability through innovation and tooling evolution


 Professional Development
   

  

* Own and drive personal and professional development in line with Dyson frameworks
* Use internal development tools to assess capability and define growth objectives
* Continuously build technical and stakeholder management expertise


**Person Specification / Core Competencies**
 You must possess strong technical product management capability, with the ability to bridge engineering needs and IT delivery. You will demonstrate strong organisational skills, stakeholder engagement, and the ability to manage complexity in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong product management capability within technical or engineering environments
* Ability to translate complex requirements into structured product roadmaps
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to prioritise and manage competing demands at pace
* Strong organisational and delivery focus


**Essential**
* Experience managing technical products within engineering or R\&D environments
* Strong experience with PLM platforms, particularly Siemens Teamcenter
* Experience managing change and enhancement within large\-scale engineering systems
* Experience working across delivery teams, architects, and business stakeholders
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and product direction


 Desirable
   

  

* Experience working within global, matrixed organisations
* Experience collaborating with external partners and vendors
* Exposure to engineering toolchains including simulation, CAE, or software development platforms


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

jobs.description:
About the Role  

  

Join the **Data Analytics (DA)** team at **TII** across domains such as **Marketing and Digital, Merchandising, Supply Chain and Logistics, Store Operations, Finance** and more**.** Here you'll collaborate with business leaders to turn data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You’ll be part of a fast\-moving, high\-impact environment focused on leveraging business intelligence and advanced analytics to solve real\-world problems.  

This role combines technical expertise with business understanding to uncover and communicate actionable insights using cutting\-edge statistical and analytical techniques.  

  

Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of data scientists, engineers and analysts. The Target Data \& Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data\-based decisions at Target. We help develop the technology that personalizes the guest experience, from product recommendations to relevant ad content. We’re also the source of the data and analytics behind Target’s Internet of Things (iOT) applications, fraud detection, Supply Chain optimization and demand forecasting. We play a key role in identifying the test\-and\-measure or A/B test opportunities that continuously help Target improve the guest experience, whether they love to shop in stores or at Target.com.


Key Responsibilities:  

 Demonstrate thought leadership in the application of data, analytics, and AI to  

influence merchandising strategy and outcomes  

 Independently translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical  

approaches, including scenario, decision, and action modelling  

 Partner with Target business stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmaps,  

validate analytical requirements, and present insights and recommendations with  

clarity and impact  

 Design, develop, and deliver analytical and AI\-driven solutions (including GenAI,  

Agent, and Agentic approaches) that enable decision support, forecasting,  

optimization, and automation  

 Apply advanced analytics techniques, including causal, predictive, and prescriptive  

analytics, to drive deeper understanding of business levers and inform optimal  

actions  

 Work with large\-scale datasets using platforms such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, and  

SQL\-based data warehouses; build and maintain reliable data pipelines using Airflow  

or similar orchestration tools  

 Evaluate and monitor AI\-driven analytical workflows, defining quality metrics (e.g.,  

accuracy, relevance), assessing reliability, and measuring tangible business impact  

 Synthesize complex analyses into compelling narratives; act as a strong storyteller  

who can influence executive and merchant audiences using data  

 Develop strong business acumen and cultivate trusted relationships with internal  

clients and partners  

 Create high\-quality analytical and AI solution artifacts, documenting methodologies,  

assumptions, models, and decision logic  

 Contribute to knowledge\-sharing systems that support reuse, iteration, and  

continuous improvement of analytical models and approaches  

 Ensure compliance with corporate data protection standards and embed responsible  

AI practices, including data privacy, bias mitigation, and explainability  

 Stay current with industry trends, emerging methodologies, and best practices in  

analytics, AI, and retail decision science

**Your Job**
We are seeking a Data Analyst to support Data Quality (DQ) and Master Data Management (MDM) activities that enable reliable business processes and data\-driven decision making. In this role, you will work closely with business users, data stewards, and technology teams to help maintain accurate and trusted data across enterprise systems. You will have opportunities to analyze data, resolve issues, improve processes, and contribute to data governance initiatives.

**Our Team**


You will join a collaborative team focused on improving data quality and maintaining trusted master data that supports key business operations. The team partners closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure enterprise data remains accurate, consistent, and actionable.

**What You Will Do**  

  



* Improve business decision\-making by monitoring data quality metrics, reports, and exception trends.
* Perform data profiling, validation, and reconciliation activities to identify and remediate data quality issues.
* Support root\-cause investigations and drive resolution of data quality incidents and remediation actions.
* Assist with developing and maintaining data quality rules, controls, and validation processes.
* Create, update, and maintain master data records, including customer, material, and reference data.
* Execute approved master data changes within ERP and MDM platforms while ensuring compliance with data standards.
* Conduct quality reviews before and after master data updates to maintain data integrity.
* Build and maintain Excel\-based reports, dashboards, and data validation tools.
* Write SQL queries to analyze data, identify trends, and support issue resolution.
* Support data migration, testing, and validation activities for system enhancements and business projects.
* Document findings, business rules, and process improvements while effectively communicating results to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business partners to identify opportunities to improve data quality and master data processes.

* 1\-3 years of experience in Data analysis, Data quality, Master data management, reporting, data governance, or related data management functions.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, charts, and data analysis features.
* Experience writing SQL queries using joins, filtering, aggregation, and data retrieval techniques.
* Experience analyzing, validating, or reconciling data sets.
* Knowledge of data quality, data governance, or data management concepts.
* Experience working with large datasets from multiple sources.
* Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.

* Experience gained through internships, academic projects, or professional work involving data analysis or reporting.
